feedback.problem:
Find the standard matrix that represents  the  linear  transformation $T$, where

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}y \\ x\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
We require a $2\times 2$ matrix $T$ such that
    

$$
T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0\cdot x+1\cdot y \\ 1\cdot x+0\cdot y\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}y \\ x\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $T$ is
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$
